note: 7-type taxonomy. v2.0 merges QUA (qualifier loss) into GRA (granularity mismatch).

codes.name: Hallucination
codes.definition: Extracted concept does not exist in the decision text

codes.name: Omission
codes.definition: Concept exists in source but extraction is incomplete

codes.name: Granularity mismatch
codes.definition: Concept at wrong level of specificity — either wrong abstraction level (e.g., generic principle instead of specific criterion) or missing essential qualifier (e.g., 'improvido' instead of 'parcialmente conhecido e não provido')
codes.note: Subsumes former QUA (qualifier loss) code from v1.0

codes.name: Misattribution
codes.definition: Content attributed to wrong party or court

codes.name: Anchoring failure
codes.definition: Content linked to wrong legal provision

codes.name: Type error
codes.definition: Content placed in wrong structured field
